label: Finding-70
title: fix-bailout: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: ChangeLog dates the four releases 22 Oct 2026, a day after the release: php-net-changelog-8 lists 'Version 8.5.12 / 22 Oct 2026' (and the same for 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35) although php.net and the Foundation say they shipped 21 Oct. Not a problem for this claim, but any page that dates the fix from the ChangeLog would be a day off.
